title: Terminal and Vector
author: Jonah Sandoval
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
